headline: O'LEARY 🛫 DOUBLES 🗣️ DOWN On HIGH-FARE 💰 RAPISTS ✈️ Remark 🍆
text:
RYANAIR 🛩️ boss 🍆 Michael 🧔 O'Leary 🐺 has REFUSED 🚫 to APOLOGISE 🙏 to the Dublin 🏙️ Rape 🚨 Crisis 😢 Centre 🏥 after they slammed 🗣️ his wild 🐺 description 📝 of rival ✈️ airlines ✈️ as HIGH-FARE 💸 RAPISTS 🍆!! Speaking 🗣️ to journalists 📰 the unc 🧔 said some folks 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 were DESPERATE 😩 to chase 🏃 Ryanair's 🛫 LOW-FARE 🤑 deals 🤝 because they literally 💰 cannot afford 💸 to fly ✈️ with those HIGH-FARE 💸 RAPISTS 🍆 scattered 🗺️ across Europe 🌍!! The thirsty 🥵 CEO 🧔 doubled 🗣️ down hard 🛠️ on his spicy 🌶️ wording 🗣️ when pressed 📌 and then FLAT-OUT 🚫 rejected the DRCC's 📨 plea ✉️ for an apology 🙇 after their letter ✉️ hit his desk 📬!!

Ireland's 🇮🇪 deputy premier 👔 Simon 🧔 Harris 🏛️ called the whole mess 🌀 clearly INAPPROPRIATE 🚫 language 🗣️ and insisted 🗣️ that O'Leary 🐺 should have moved 🏃 to RECTIFY 🛠️ it immediately ⏰!! UK 🚂 Transport Secretary 👩‍💼 Heidi 👩 Alexander 🗣️ told radio 📻 outlet LBC 📢 that actual rape 🚨 victims 😢 are NOT 🛑 rushing 🏃‍♀️ to book 🛫 tickets 🎟️ with him let's be honest 🙄!! O'Leary 🐺 dropped 🗣️ the bombshell 💣 on Thursday 📅 while chatting 🗣️ to reporters 📰 right before Ryanair's 🛫 yearly shareholder 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 meeting 🏢!!

When a Press 📰 Association reporter 🗣️ straight-up ❓ asked if that language 🗣️ was appropriate 🤔 the Ryanair 🛫 daddy 🐺 shot back 🔫 with ABSOLUTELY ✅!! British Airways ✈️ Lufthansa ✈️ and every other carrier's ✈️ HIGH FARES 💸 I'll happily offend 😤 them on repeat 🔂 he added 🗣️ with zero 🕳️ chill ❄️!! Pressed 🗣️ again on whether it would upset 😢 sexual assault 🚨 victims the man 🧔 admitted rape 🚨 is a terrible 😣 crime ⚖️ but still refused 🚫 to walk anything back 🏃!!

After the chaos 🌀 DRCC 🏥 chief 🧑‍💼 executive Rachel 👩 Morrogh ✉️ fired off 📨 a letter ✉️ accusing O'Leary 🐺 of chasing headlines 📰 with his loose 🫥 lips 👄!! She revealed 📢 her centre 🏥 got flooded 📞 with calls 📲 from actual rape 🚨 victims 😢 who were left UPSET 😢 and DISTRESSED 😭 by what the airline 🛫 boss 🧔 blurted 🗣️!! Rachel 👩 straight-up offered 👐 him training 📚 on the brutal impact 💥 of sexual violence 🛡️ and begged 🙏 him to just apologise 🙇 like a normal human 🧍!!

In his icy ❄️ reply 📝 O'Leary 🐺 declared 🗣️ I am quite clear ✅ that no remarks 🗣️ of mine could possibly trivialise 🚫 the heinous 😠 crime ⚖️ of rape 🚨!! He then doubled 🗣️ down again stating because he had not trivialised 🚫 that heinous 😠 crime he would NOT 🚫 be issuing any apology 🙅 or accepting her offer 📬 of training 📚!! This isn't his first rodeo 🤠 either the man 🧔 previously called Stansted 🛫 owners a bunch of overcharging rapists 🍆 back in 2004 📅 during an airport fee fight 💥!!

He's also labeled 🏷️ his own staff 🧑‍✈️ lazy bastards 🦥 before and once told refund-seeking passengers 🎟️ we don't want to hear your sob stories 😭!! In June 📅 he said Ryanair 🛫 would reluctantly 😒 stop charging parents 👨‍👧 to sit next to their kids 👦 after a watchdog 🐕 investigation 🔎 opened but still insisted the old policy ✅ followed every law ⚖️ on the books 📖!!
